# JNJ — Catalysts

## TL;DR

The BofA Healthcare Conference on May 12 (~5 trading days) is the live near-term catalyst window — management could update on IMAAVY (nipocalimab) FDA Priority Review progress and Darzalex trajectory. Positive commentary could trigger short-covering from deeply oversold levels (RSI 27.22). Analyst consensus Buy with avg PT ~$249 implies ~10%+ upside to current levels, but consensus has been wrong for 21 trading days of decline. Next binary: Q2 2026 earnings (~July 15–22). Risk-off macro (Iran-UAE conflict, Fed hold) partially removes the defensive rotation bid. Ongoing structural risks: talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) and Stelara biosimilar erosion from AbbVie/Amgen. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260505_194525.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| BofA Healthcare Conference | May 12, 2026 | Watch — IMAAVY and Darzalex guidance; positive commentary triggers short-covering risk |
| Quarterly dividend ex-date | May 26, 2026 | $1.34/share declared; income signal, not a price mover |
| RBC Capital Markets Global Healthcare Conference | May 19, 2026 | Second near-term appearance — additional pipeline commentary risk |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 15–22, 2026 | Next binary — analyst Q2 EPS est. ~$2.84; Stelara erosion rate vs Darzalex growth is key read |
| IMAAVY FDA review decision | TBD (Priority Review granted) | Priority Review for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia; Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 positive in myasthenia gravis |
| Talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) | Unscheduled | Largest unquantifiable binary — settlement or adverse ruling creates a gap |

## Recent news synthesis

**BofA Healthcare Conference May 12 confirmed** — key watch event. RBC follows May 19. Both are near-term risks for the active short (id 116, 3 shares). Positive IMAAVY or Darzalex commentary could force short-covering. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

**IMAAVY and Vivacity-MG3 pipeline update (April–May 2026).** IMAAVY (nipocalimab) has FDA Priority Review for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia; Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 data was positive for myasthenia gravis (presented at American Academy of Neurology 2026 Meeting). Pipeline building momentum — a positive catalyst risk for the short. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

**Caplyta favorable efficacy data (May 4, 2026).** Network meta-analysis shows favorable outcomes vs approved antipsychotics for MDD add-on treatment, no significant weight gain. Pipeline positive; not a near-term price driver. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

**Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 14, 2026) — fully absorbed.** Revenue $24.1B (+10% YoY, beat $23.6B est); Darzalex $4B vs $3.4B est; Tremfya $1.6B vs $1.2B est; GAAP net income fell 52.4% on talc reserve. Muted +0.5–1% reaction confirmed trapped-longs absorption. 2026 outlook raised (adj. EPS $11.55, sales midpoint $100.8B). (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

**Stelara biosimilar headwind — ongoing.** AbbVie and Amgen biosimilar launches are the primary competitive erosion. Royalty Pharma $500M Icotyde partnership is the recovery vehicle. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

**Lexeo Therapeutics partnership — new niche.** JNJ partnered with Lexeo Therapeutics for cardiac gene therapy delivery, opening a new competitive niche. Long-term strategic; not a near-term price driver. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

## Analyst consensus

Avg PT ~$249.25 (range $208–$285); 19 of 23 analysts Buy as of April 21, 2026. Morgan Stanley raised PT to $262 (January 28). Price ~$226 is ~10%+ below consensus — implied upside, but the confirmed downtrend reflects institutional disagreement with near-term timing. (Source: analyst_consensus, web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260505_194525.)

## Insider activity

No activity recorded across all recent runs. Absence of insider buying at a 21-trading-day low is a mild bear signal — insiders are not stepping in to defend the stock. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent, signals_combined.json, run 20260505_194525.)

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
